notifications.title: Weekly loop: cycle 2 starts (promise beat stays in the hook's place); your tune note is now the default
notifications.detail: Cycle 1 (the real person's photo or the company's logo in the first frame) closed on 19 Nov at your word, before its verdict. What it had measured, simple means of the Shorts with 48 h data: stayed to watch 38.0% without it (5 Shorts) vs 35.8% with it (9 Shorts), so no sign it helped; it stays the default as you asked, and the loop will show if it hurts. Channel stayed to watch, last 14 days: 37.9%, down from 44.4% before. Last week's Shorts (16 Nov on, 6 with data): median 400 views in 48 h, 30.8 s average view. Tonight: your 17 Nov sound note (the same background every Short) went straight in, as you asked on 19 Nov: every new Short has its own short tune in the pauses, a different instrument and melody each time. Cycle 2 tests the auditor's worst picture: the promise beat at 5-8 s lost 22 points on average in 10 of 11 Shorts, nearly always after a whip to a new place; half the Shorts now stay in the hook's place and move on with one camera move. Judged on held after the hook, from 8 Shorts a side, verdict by 28 Nov.
notifications.fix: Nothing to do. If cycle 1's photo-in-the-hook rule should be tested after all, leave a note and it goes back on the list.
